ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported the repurchase of 26,000 equity shares on October 12, 2026, via the NSE at an average price of ₹269.3825, increasing its cumulative repurchases to 1,867,482 as part of an ongoing open market buyback program. This daily transaction reflects the company's continued strategy to reduce outstanding shares, which typically aims to enhance shareholder value and improve earnings per share, with no red flags apparent in this routine disclosure.
